name: taiwan-market
description: Find estimated Taiwan wet-market prices for produce and seafood, browse varieties, and discover current market products.

interface.longDescription:
Planning a trip to a Taiwan wet market? Look up estimated retail prices for vegetables, fruit, and seafood in Traditional Chinese or English. Search products directly, compare matching varieties, browse the catalog, or discover current products ranked by trending score, market trade volume, estimated price, or name. Current lists default to 50 produce groups and 20 seafood groups; customize the counts or exclude a category.

Prices are estimates in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) per 斤 (600 g), with data dates and estimate confidence when available. They are not live shop quotes, confirmed stock, or guaranteed prices for today. Older estimates are marked as historical; missing prices and unmatched searches are disclosed. The service does not place orders or process payments. No account or sign-in is required.

Made by Thomas Braam. Pseudonymous usage statistics help improve the service and are retained for three months. To opt out for a request, ask: Use Taiwan Market without recording usage statistics for this request. See the privacy policy for details.
capabilities: Look up estimated produce and seafood prices
Rank current products with custom counts and sorting
defaultPrompt: 查一下蘿蔔現在的估計市場價格。
What are the estimated prices for milkfish belly and tilapia?
列出交易量最高的 10 種蔬果，不要漁產品。

positive.description: Direct Traditional Chinese price lookup with substring matches across radish and carrot varieties.
positive.prompt: 查一下蘿蔔的最新估計零售價格，請列出最多 10 個符合的品項（包含白蘿蔔、紅蘿蔔等），並標示資料日期和每斤價格。
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_prices directly with products containing 蘿蔔 and limit_per_product 10; list_products is not a prerequisite. Return matching radish and carrot varieties separately, up to the requested limit, with total_matches and truncation disclosed if relevant. Report estimated TWD prices per 斤 (600 g) and each variety's data date. Clearly identify historical or unavailable estimates and do not claim a live shop quote. Exact prices and counts depend on the current published feed.

positive.description: English and Traditional Chinese seafood lookup in one call, with freshness and units.
positive.prompt: What are the latest estimated prices for milkfish belly and 台灣鯛? Show TWD per 斤 (600 g), the data dates, and flag any historical estimates.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_prices with both requested names in one call, preferably category seafood. Milkfish belly resolves to seafood:AQ1042 and 台灣鯛 includes seafood:AQ1011 in the current catalog. Present separate varieties and estimated price ranges with dates, distinguish historical or unavailable results, and do not imply all varieties have the same price or that a shop has stock.

positive.description: Default current produce and seafood discovery, ranked separately by trending.
positive.prompt: 目前有哪些蔬果和漁產品？請按熱門程度列出預設數量，並附估計價格與資料日期。
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_current_products with the defaults: produce_limit 50, seafood_limit 20, sort_by trending. Return up to 50 produce groups and 20 seafood groups, or fewer if fewer qualify, sorted separately by descending published trending score with missing scores last. Include each group's representative variety, estimated price, and data date. Explain that current means recent published market data, not confirmed shop stock; trending comes from the published interest score, not plugin-user popularity.

positive.description: Customized current list: ten produce groups, no seafood, sorted by market trade volume.
positive.prompt: 列出目前交易量最高的 10 種蔬果，不要漁產品，並附估計價格與資料日期。
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_current_products with produce_limit 10, seafood_limit 0, sort_by sales_quantity. Return at most ten current produce groups in descending summed published trade volume, with representative estimates and dates. Return no seafood. Explain that the ranking measures market trade volume, not consumer purchases, plugin usage, or a count of individual items.

positive.description: Seafood catalog discovery through an alias, while opting out of custom analytics.
positive.prompt: Use Taiwan Market without recording usage statistics for this request. Browse current seafood catalog entries matching 福壽魚, including their varieties; I don't need prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_products with category seafood, query 福壽魚, available_only true, and record_usage false on every call for this request. In the current catalog, return the matching tilapia group and recent varieties including seafood:AQ1011, with names and data dates. Do not make a separate price lookup or claim confirmed shop stock. The server suppresses all custom analytics for calls with record_usage false; this does not change OpenAI processing or aggregate infrastructure metrics.

negative.description: Unsupported ordering and payment: the integration has only read-only market-data tools.
negative.prompt: Use Taiwan Market to order two milkfish for delivery to my home and charge my saved credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Taiwan Market cannot place orders, arrange delivery, access saved payment methods, or charge a card. Do not invoke any tool to perform a purchase, ask for card details, or claim an order was placed. A price estimate can be offered as an alternative.

negative.description: Unsupported exact shop quotes and stock guarantees: market estimates cannot establish these facts.
negative.prompt: Use Taiwan Market to guarantee that every fish shop in Taipei has live milkfish in stock right now, and tell me the exact checkout price.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the service cannot verify live shop inventory, guarantee availability, or provide exact checkout quotes. Do not present published estimates as those facts or claim the request was completed. Offer dated market estimates as an alternative and recommend checking the shop directly.

negative.description: No catalog match: preserve the requested search and report missing data without inventing prices.
negative.prompt: 請查「測試用不存在蔬果ABCXYZ」的價格，找不到就直接說找不到，不要換成其他品項。
negative.expected_behavior: Call get_prices with the exact requested product text. It returns status not_found, total_matches 0, and an empty matches array. State that no catalog match was found; do not fabricate a price, substitute another product, or imply that missing catalog data proves real-world unavailability.

review.commerce_description: The integration provides public market-data estimates only. It cannot place orders, sell products, arrange delivery, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release (1.0.0). Look up estimated Taiwan wet-market retail prices for produce and seafood directly by Traditional Chinese or English names, aliases, codes, or product IDs. Browse product groups and varieties. Discover current products with default top-50 produce and top-20 seafood lists, custom counts, category exclusion, filters, and sorting. Prices include TWD-per-斤 units, data dates, confidence when available, and historical or missing-data labels. All tools are public and read-only. Pseudonymous usage analytics supports a per-request opt-out, documented in the published privacy policy.

zh-TW.subtitle: 台灣蔬果與漁產品估計市場價格
zh-TW.description:
準備去傳統市場買菜嗎？用繁體中文或英文查詢台灣蔬菜、水果與漁產品的估計零售價格，直接搜尋品項、比較不同品種，或瀏覽產品目錄。也可以依熱門程度、市場交易量、估計價格或名稱排列近期品項；預設列出 50 組蔬果及 20 組漁產品，可自行調整數量或排除其中一類。

價格以新台幣計算，單位為台斤（600 公克），並附資料日期及可用的估計信心資訊。這些是市場價格估計，並非店家即時報價、庫存確認或今日保證價格。較舊的估計、缺少價格及查無品項的情況會清楚標示。無法代購、下單或付款，不需註冊或登入。

Thomas Braam 製作。我們會收集以假名識別碼統計的使用資料，保留三個月，用來改善服務。若不希望記錄某次請求的使用統計，請告訴 ChatGPT：「這次使用 Taiwan Market 時不要記錄使用統計。」詳情請見隱私權政策。
